title: Jude and the Terminal
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
